physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Cassiopeia A is recorded: it is an extended remnant, and its package frames it at 2.52 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), the forward shock's radius, 153 arcsec (DeLaney et al. 2010, Sect. IV.1).

sources.position: Thorstensen, Fesen & van den Bergh (2001), AJ 122, 297: the expansion center and dynamical age of Cassiopeia A: its expansion center, 23h 23m 27.77s, +58° 48' 49.4" (ICRS) (https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/0104188)
sources.distance: Thorstensen, Fesen & van den Bergh (2001), AJ 122, 297: the expansion center and dynamical age of Cassiopeia A: a distance of 3.4 kpc (https://arxiv.org/abs/astro-ph/0104188)
sources.properMotion: Zero: the remnant is held at its expansion centre; no motion across the sky is applied.
